name: @antv/x6
notes: X6 v3 core bundles common, geometry and the official plugins. The browser bundle works with a tslib workaround; native Node ESM/CJS loading fails in the published package. MIT, no install scripts, no npm provenance. React nodes use the separately reviewed @antv/x6-react-shape 3.0.1.
provenance_note: No npm attestation was found when these facts were collected.

prior_versions.note: Deprecated v2 bridge for the existing application. Pin 2.19.2 with compatible 2.x plugins and record the no-provenance gap. The 12-month maintenance window closes on 2026-11-17, so remove v2 by that date or record a new time-boxed exception. Do not mix 2.x plugins with v3.
